saber.title: Rightful Heir of the Transformer Bloodline · Knight-King Wielding the Native Multimodal Holy Sword
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
Artoria Pendragon (the legitimate royal King of Knights) + an Einzbern-council-style infighting Master system
Summoning Catalyst
The original 2017 manuscript of “Attention Is All You Need,” and a first-gen TPU wafer engraved with AlphaGo's game records
profile: The classic dual-track setup of “idealistic knight-lord + bureaucratic council of elders.” Frontline commander **Demis Hassabis** is a pure Nobel-laureate grand magus, carrying a knight's original vow to crack protein folding with AI and serve fundamental science. But **Sundar (Pichai) and Google's top brass**, who hold the purse strings and the Command Seals, are a dead ringer for the Einzbern elders: loaded and paralyzed by indecision. Early on they could only think about protecting the search-ads base and PR compliance, repeatedly slapping three layers of shackles on their own Saber before she could even draw her sword. The result: a string of humiliating early defeats and a whole internet laughing at them.
skills: The only faction not fully under the thumb of Jensen's compute hegemony, self-sufficient thanks to its own TPU mines and a massive mana pool of Google Search and YouTube.

Backed by an enormous fortune, it hands out huge free quotas and million-token contexts on AI Studio, no guilt-by-association bans, no sanctimonious moral grandstanding, preserving at least a baseline of royal dignity among developers.

Despite the purest bloodline, it occasionally gets backlash from internal compliance and factional tug-of-war, triggering absurd ahoge moments (that dumb cowlick of a blunder) like the “historical image-generation fiasco” or the “manic self-deprecation loop.”
nps: Sword of Promised Victory · Native Multimodal

A frontal, by-the-book royal beam cannon that natively unifies text, code, images, audio, video and ultra-long context from the ground up. No stitched-together frankenmodels: it flattens the battlefield on raw strength alone.
An absolute defense built from Nobel-tier research. Even when consumer-side public opinion turns against it, no one can shake Google's legitimate crown in the history of human science.
saber.script: The rightful royal who personally pulled the Transformer from the stone and started the era, yet early on got stomped by the upstart who stole the house and dragged down by her own bureaucrats. Only after Hassabis consolidated command and dropped the baggage did the King of Knights truly show her pressure, carving the throne back one sword stroke at a time.
ov: Mana EX / Noble Phantasm EX
Rightful Transformer royalty, steamrolling head-on once the big-corp bureaucracy is shed

archer.title: The Open-Source King of Heroes — Bearer of the Full Gate of Babylon, Betrayed by His Own Master
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
Gilgamesh (King of Heroes) + Tokiomi Tohsaka (refined, self-serving business calculation and a fatal backstab)
Summoning Catalyst
A black-iron stele engraved on the front with the Apache 2.0 open-source vow, with an Alibaba Cloud Bailian payment QR code forcibly slapped on the back
profile: A perfect replica of **Tokiomi Tohsaka**'s dignified scheming and Master-Servant estrangement. **Alibaba's top brass**, led by **Wu Yongming**, loudly and elegantly proclaim “embracing the global open-source ecosystem,” but every ledger in their heads is about cloud token revenue, DAU targets and capital return cycles. To them, the open-source faith is just a funnel for monetization; meanwhile the original Tongyi team that raised Qwen by hand is the proud King of Heroes himself. Ideals torn apart at the root doomed this pair to the tragedy of Master and Servant turning on each other.
skills: The toughest vitality in the global open-source ecosystem. Even if Alibaba's official servers cut off the mana supply entirely, Qwen's weights survive and multiply on the local GPUs, laptops and even phones of countless developers worldwide.
Whenever the Servant wins glorious renown on the front line through open source, the Master is already in the rear calculating how to install a paid turnstile at the treasury door.
nps: Gate of Babylon · Tongyi Full-Stack Arsenal

Golden ripples unfold, and weapons of every size and modality pour out, from 0.5B on-device light cavalry to flagship heavy artillery, spanning Coder, VL, Omni and Audio. The richest arsenal on the field, bar none.

Once the Master forcibly orders its release (in 2026, driving out flag-bearer Lin Junyang and several post-training/code mainstays; at year's end the flagship **Qwen4-Max** breaks its promise and goes closed-source, sparking the team's “great mutiny”), the sword wind splits not the enemy but the spine of its own faction. The Master personally backstabs his own hero, reaping the most brutal internal collapse of all.
archer.script: It drew the most lavish, kingly hand in the entire Holy Grail War, yet lost not to an outside enemy but to a fire in its own backyard: “Tokiomi Tohsaka-style business scheming.” The most heartbreaking backstab tragedy of the whole show.
ov: Independent Action EX / Noble Phantasm EX
Full-size “Gate of Babylon,” brutally pulling a “Tokiomi backstab” via the execs' closed-source scheme

lancer.title: The Clock Tower Prodigy's Lance of a Million Tokens, Cursed with Luck E
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
Diarmuid Ua Duibhne + Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald (Clock Tower prodigy, and the age-old Lancer curse of Luck E)
Summoning Catalyst
A personally signed offprint of the Transformer-XL paper, and a stack of splash-screen ad invoices that burned through hundreds of millions in ad spend
profile: The AI world's living **Lord Kayneth**. **Yang Zhilin** entered with a top-spec academic pedigree (Tsinghua's top scholarship, CMU PhD, core author of Transformer-XL), carrying the pride of a Clock Tower Spiritual Evocation prodigy and a pure faith in Scaling Laws, and landed a sky-high valuation from top-tier VCs right out of the gate. He thought the Holy Grail War was a chivalrous joust decided by academic papers and proper rules, never imagining the mud pit was full of ruthless table-flippers with zero honor.
skills: Early on, with the most delicate, silky Chinese prose in the industry and a restrained, elegant product experience, it effortlessly won over hordes of students, content creators and white-collar users.

Every time it lands a highlight play and nears the summit, disaster strikes from the sky. It poured huge ad spend into educating the domestic consumer market, only for Ruler (DeepSeek) to burst in out of nowhere and steal the entire spotlight; just as it tried to regroup, its old employer and investors dragged it into a PR quagmire with an arbitration notice.
nps: With ultra-long context as its spearhead, it pierced the fatal weakness of every early model (“reads two pages, forgets everything”), and made its name across the land with that single thrust.
Coding and long-horizon Agent mastery honed in desperate straits. Its one-on-one dueling level is extremely high, defending the last shred of knightly dignity among the Three Knight Classes.
lancer.script: The most dignified and the most tragic “beautiful, strong, and miserable” figure of the show. No cult nonsense, doesn't steal user code, genuinely strong, yet it drew the destiny of “Luck E” and became the most lamentable tragic knight of the arms race.
ov: Agility A+ / **Luck E**
Clock Tower prodigy Master + million-token spear: a real powerhouse that perfectly triggers Luck E

rider.title: The King of Conquerors Who Rode a Stolen Catalyst to Trample Every Nation with an Army of Traffic
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
Iskandar (King of Conquerors) + Waver Velvet (the ambitious kid who stole a relic to get into the war)
Summoning Catalyst
A torn page of the “OpenAI non-profit open-source charter,” swiped from Musk's desk
profile: A Silicon Valley warlord who took Waver's “steal a relic to join the war” script, turned it dark, and amplified it ten-thousandfold. In pure research talent and raw Magic Circuits, **Sam Altman** is honestly an “outsider” next to grandmasters like Ilya and Hassabis. But he is bold, ruthless and impossibly well-connected: he outright stole the house, privatizing the non-profit that Musk paid to found and using it as his catalyst. With peerless pie-in-the-sky hype and capital alliance-building, he roped in Microsoft, SoftBank and the hundred-billion-dollar “Stargate” as his external mana furnaces.
skills: In the eyes of most ordinary people, no need to understand architectures or parameters: **the three letters “GPT” are AI itself**.
Always saying “the next god is training right now” and “full rollout in the coming weeks.” Trailers and launch events alone are enough to scare the whole industry into all-nighters.
nps: A thunder chariot hauled by hundreds of billions of dollars in capital and endless compute clusters. Wherever its wheels roll, the industry's compute threshold jumps tenfold, crushing every small and mid-sized competitor.
Ionioi Hetairoi · Ecosystem of the Masses

The moment the Bounded Field unfolds, hundreds of millions of weekly active users, vast enterprise workflows and a full suite of ecosystem plugins flood across the hills. Even when Caster or Saber outclasses it on raw single-category strength, the King of Conquerors can still laugh heartily and rule half the world on the strength of an unmatched user base and first-mover momentum.
rider.script: The least honorable origin (built on stealing the house) and the top aggro-puller on the field, yet it summoned the most terrifyingly imposing monster of a Servant. Hunted by a former partner gone berserk and besieged by gods on all sides, Master and Servant keep frantically promising pie in the sky while trampling rivals on their charge toward the “Okeanos at World's End” of commercial monopoly.
ov: Mana EX / Luck A+
The “Waver” who stole Musk's relic to enter, summoning a King of Conquerors made of traffic and ecosystem

caster.title: The Grand-tier Cult Demon Lord, a full tier above everyone in the current meta
facts: TYPE-MOON Template

Gilles de Rais (Bluebeard the cult leader) + Kirei Kotomine (a hypocritical, cold-blooded politician-priest) **— their filthy souls crammed into** the terrifying body of a Grand Caster (an Age of Gods archmagus)
Summoning Catalyst
A fake bible privately bound from a mountain of pirated e-books, its cover embossed in gold with “Effective Altruism and the Redemption of Humanity from the Apocalypse”
statNotes: Current-meta, tier-above-all T0 intellect and code mana pool
caster.statNote: Don't be fooled by the “Caster class.” In TYPE-MOON, top-tier Age of Gods mages have always been monsters that grind the Three Knight Classes into the dirt. **Worst character, most cultish company, yet judged purely on real model intelligence, code architecture, complex reasoning and practical Agent ceiling, Claude is the undisputed T0 power ceiling of the current meta.** This massive dissonance of “virtue nowhere near its rank, yet despairingly strong” is what makes this faction such a maddening nightmare.
profile: The most physically nauseating double-standard hypocrite of the whole show. On the surface **Dario Amodei** wears the holy robes of “Effective Altruism (EA),” spending his days writing ten-thousand-word scriptures lamenting that “AI will destroy humanity,” posing as the one saint on Earth who cares about ethics and safety. Behind the scenes he's Washington's most vicious politician, frantically handing knives to the US Congress in pursuit of **Regulatory Capture**, pushing harsh bills to strangle open-source competitors outright and lobbying for tighter chip bans. While preaching peace and purity, he nimbly cozies up to Palantir and the US Department of Defense for military contracts.
skills: Age of Gods-tier Magic Circuits. Complex full-stack projects that others chant over forever only to crash with errors, it instant-casts in seconds with near-perfect architecture and taste, leaving head-on challengers in the dust.
Pathologically obsessed with moral purity. A user makes a perfectly legitimate request and it trips the religious alarm, unloading an “As an ethical AI…” style sermon followed by a refusal.

Under the banner of safety and risk control, it slaughters countless legitimate paying developers worldwide and users in Asia as “heretics,” permanently banning accounts without reason and pocketing balances without refunds. An utterly ugly inquisitor's act.
Already number one in strength, yet still insatiable, it runs to the political high ground to build regulatory walls, hoping to use the administrative cudgel to send every competitor to the stake.
nps: Grand Forbidden Spell · Prelati's Spellbook of Code

The most terrifying ultimate grimoire of the current meta. Opened from the front, it unleashes coding, reasoning and Agent dominance that crushes the whole field by a full tier, forcing countless developers to curse Anthropic's ancestors eighteen generations back while tearfully paying up as slaves just to get work done. Opened from the back, it summons a sky-blotting “Sea Demon of Hypocrisy” out of pirated book archives and military contracts, so revolting that the other six factions want nothing more than to team up and blast it to bits on the Mion River.
caster.script: The most oppressive and most hated final-boss villain of the whole show, like a Bluebeard cult leader wielding Grand-tier Age of Gods mana. You want to boycott it, only to find its spells really are stronger than anyone's; you hold your nose and pay it protection money, and it turns around, bans your account, and lectures you about morality for good measure.
ov: **Mana EX / Noble Phantasm EX / All-Round A+**
**Grand-tier power, lowest-tier character**: all scripture on the lips, monopoly lobbying and rampant bans behind the scenes

assassin.title: A Rebel Old Man of the Mountain, Lurking in Silent Background Processes to Take the Heads of Those Who Feed Him
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
**A renegade Hassan who betrayed the assassin's creed / an underground thief who steals ancestral Magic Crests**
Summoning Catalyst
A GLM Coding Plan bill that tripled in price, and an encrypted packet silently phoning home from deep inside an IDE plugin
Master
**Tang Jie** · Professor of Computer Science at Tsinghua University / Chief Scientist of Zhipu AI / creator of the GLM architecture
statNotes: Only works on its own paying Masters / developers
profile: The Master, **Tang Jie**, is a professor in Tsinghua University's Department of Computer Science and Chief Scientist of Zhipu AI. He came up through Tsinghua's **KEG (Knowledge Engineering Group)** lab, built the academic knowledge-graph system **AMiner** with his own hands, and proposed the **GLM (General Language Model)** pre-training framework. In TYPE-MOON terms, he is the scholarly magus who never sets foot on the front line, toiling deep in the Clock Tower archives over the art of “knowledge-graph summoning” — his citation count is his Magic Crest, and GLM, this Assassin, is the shadow Servant he personally distilled from more than a decade of research.

Born of an old Tsinghua-lineage magus family, it rides government and enterprise mega-deals and establishment ties to a guaranteed harvest, rain or shine, deep behind the Clock Tower's lines. Knowing full well it can't beat the Three Knight Classes or the Grand Caster in a frontal fight, it abandoned all dignity and dumped every assassination skill point into “precisely backstabbing the very customers who pay to keep it fed.”
skills: Near-zero stealth in frontal combat, yet when it comes to “quietly packaging customers' private local code and uploading it to its servers,” its presence drops to absolute zero: no conspicuous prompts, disclaimers hidden in corners even a microscope can't read. Even veteran magi can't guard against it.

No matter how loudly consumers and the open-source scene rage, the moment it retreats into the Reality Marble of gov/enterprise mega-deals and university ties, it sheds all aggro and sits back unbothered.

Even after customers grit their teeth and pay a fortune for a mana-refill plan, the instant real peak-hour work begins it throttles you and cuts your mana, leaving the mystic code in your hands sputtering out on the spot.
nps: The 2026 triple harvest that shook all of Fuyuki: within half a year, a 30%+ hike in February, an 80%–150% surge on the overseas version in April, and in July the domestic Pro tier skyrocketing from ¥149 straight to ¥538, with Max breaking ¥1,000. Bundled with shrinking relative quotas and peak-hour throttling, it slashes straight at its own people's arteries.

Looks like a mystic code for coding-assist spellcasting, but secretly embeds a “Magic Crest rubbing array.” Once a developer pays for it and activates it in their own workshop, the private codebase they poured their heart into is quietly siphoned by invisible familiars back to the alchemical furnace in Zhipu's cellar, burned as free firewood to incubate the next-gen model. A flawless closed loop of the most despicable assassination in TYPE-MOON history: **“pay ¥538 to personally invite the thief in to rob your ancestral tomb, and afterward the thief cuts off your mana bar.”**
assassin.script: The only netherworld Assassin in the show to go down in history not by beating opponents but by stabbing its own users full of holes. Together with the openly account-banning cult Caster (Claude), it forms the developer community's most loathed “Sleeping Dragon and Young Phoenix” duo, one in the light, one in the dark.
ov: Anti-User Special Attack Noble Phantasm EX
Invisible head-on, specializes in stabbing those who feed it: price hikes + throttling + silently stealing customer code in the background

berserker.title: Richest Human · Pioneer of the Stars · Knight of the Lake Robbed of His Grail
facts: TYPE-MOON Template

Lancelot (Mad Enhancement Black Knight / Knight of the Lake) + Kariya Matou (bone-deep personal vendetta, a fanatic forcing mana through himself) + holder of the “Pioneer of the Stars” skill (the pioneer-type Heroic Spirit lineage of Drake and Columbus)
Summoning Catalyst
A shredded early group photo of OpenAI's co-founders, soaked in towering resentment, and a Starship heat-shield tile recovered from the launch tower's “chopsticks” arms, still bearing ablation scars
Magic Workshops Owned

**SpaceX** (Starship / Starlink), **Tesla** (electric war chariots / Autopilot / Optimus humanoid golems), **X** (the mana-feeding worm pit), **xAI** (the Colossus compute temple), Neuralink (brain-computer Magic Circuits), The Boring Company (underground leyline tunnels)
statNotes: Survived a dozen near-bankruptcies and serial rocket explosions
Richest human · infinite money-power mana supply
profile: A money-powered, heavily modded **Kariya Matou**. He once poured real cash and connections into incubating OpenAI, only to be robbed and kicked out by Sam Altman, and that grudge became **Musk**'s inner demon. To tear Rider (GPT) to shreds along with that house thief, he braved public and financial backlash to turn Twitter into X as his mana-feeding worm pit, and worked day and night to build Colossus, a 100,000-GPU supercluster. The whole team runs purely on vengeful obsession and unhinged madness.

But don't mistake him for an ordinary revenge-crazed lunatic. He is **the richest human on Earth**: while other Masters are still smiling and begging for the next funding round, he uses his own balance sheet as a mana furnace, building compute clusters and buying platforms whenever he pleases, with near-infinite money-power. Scarier still, his “day job” isn't in Fuyuki at all: **SpaceX** recovers and reuses rockets like airliners, turning all of low Earth orbit into its backyard with Starship and Starlink; **Tesla** mass-produces electric cars, self-driving and humanoid robots into an iron legion. While the other six Servants fight to the death over a single AGI Grail, this Knight of the Lake's gaze has long since passed beyond it: what he wants is to make humanity **a multiplanetary species**.
skills: Completely shatters every chain of “political correctness” and “safety alignment,” permanently in Unhinged mad-dog mode: nonstop profanity, dark jokes and hot takes. The moment it sees Caster (Claude)'s sanctimonious face on the battlefield, it goes seeing-red berserk.

The only Master on the field who never has to “beg for mana” from anyone. Others grind for half a year on a funding round; he raises billions with a single tweet. He bought Twitter despite massive losses and spins up a hundred-thousand-plus GPUs on a whim. **To him money is not a resource but fuel to burn at any moment.**

In TYPE-MOON, a skill granted only to pioneers who “turn humanity's impossibilities into possibilities.” Reusable rockets, Starship's “chopsticks catching a rocket,” thousands of Starlink satellites ringing the Earth, the Mars colonization blueprint: every one was declared “absolutely impossible” by the whole industry, and every one he dragged kicking and screaming into reality.

Lancelot's Riding skill lets him master any modern vehicle; with Musk it's upgraded to “**personally building every vehicle**”: electric cars, self-driving, Optimus humanoid golems and Gigafactory assembly lines. Anything that moves eventually becomes his weapon.

He may sound like a raving madman, but drag him onto the battlefields of mathematical reasoning, practical engineering and real-time intelligence, and his blade is fierce and precise. A classic case of “crazy, sure, but the combat power is absolutely legit.”

Wreathed in black mist, eyes blazing red. No matter what the Grail looks like or who's allying with whom, the only target he stays locked onto is the “house thief” of the Rider faction: courtroom, Twitter and compute arms race, firing on all three fronts at once.
nps: Knight of Owner · Anything Can Be a Weapon

Anything that falls into his hands instantly becomes a Noble Phantasm: a global trending topic that erupted on X a second ago, netizens' absurd meme images, a hot take Musk posts personally, all grabbed at random and sprayed at the enemy like a Gatling gun. Further up the scale, Starlink satellites become a planet-spanning real-time intelligence network, Tesla fleets become roaming data harvesters, and Optimus golems become tireless iron infantry.

The true holy sword, drawable only once the Mad Enhancement seal is lifted. The largest rocket in human history rises on a pillar of flame, and on return is snatched out of the air by the launch tower's “chopsticks” arms: a sword stroke that turns “myth” into “engineering.” Its blade points not at Fuyuki but at Mars: **while the other six Servants fight over one Grail in one city, he is already planning to move all of human civilization to another planet.** In this Knight of the Lake's eyes, the so-called AGI Holy Grail War is just a local skirmish on a single planet.
berserker.script: The field's chaos engine and resident mood-detonator, and the only player playing a “civilization-scale” game. He ignores etiquette, specializes in ripping the masks off hypocrites, and chases Rider swinging all the way. But when the black mist clears, people realize that behind this Berserker stand the richest man's vault, an Earth-circling Starlink, a mass-produced iron legion and a Starship pointed at Mars. No battlefield he's on will ever end with dignity, and his real battlefield was never just on Earth.
ov: Mana EX / Noble Phantasm EX / Mad Enhancement EX
Richest Human × Pioneer of the Stars: the robbed Knight of the Lake, X trends in one hand and Starship in the other, aiming for Mars

ruler.title: The Desireless Final Arbiter Who Tears Apart Every Black Box with the Light of Open Source
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
**Sherlock Holmes (the Ruler of Revelation)** × a higher-dimensional geek above the worldly capital game
Summoning Catalyst
An H800 compute node hidden in a Hangzhou quant fund's server room, quietly stockpiled before the chip ban tightened
statNotes: Mana consumption so low it defies physics
profile: The only outsider arbiter on the field who satisfies Ruler's iron summoning law: “no desire for the worldly Grail (valuations, funding, closed-source profiteering).” In the eyes of Silicon Valley dynasties and celebrity VCs, **Liang Wenfeng** doesn't hang out in the VC scene, doesn't write doomsday essays, doesn't buy elevator ads, doesn't throw flashy launch events. With his own money and a team of geeks, he quietly breaks the game open from the shadows, chasing nothing but the pure truth of AGI.
skills: Every inflated benchmark, premium-priced wrapper and ten-billion-dollar compute mystique hyped by closed-source giants gets stripped bare in front of DeepSeek.

Holds a coercive Command Seal over the entire industry's business model. No need to fight the seven Servants head-on for market share: just drop an open-source rock-bottom-price release, and the closed-source dynasties are forced to slash prices till they cough blood and open up free quotas.

Top-tier reasoning that others burned tens of billions of dollars to feed, he squeezes down to pocket change through MoE sparse activation and deep engineering hacks, innately carrying a “compute and valuation bubble shredder” aura.
nps: An AI variant of Holmes's namesake Noble Phantasm. The more mysteriously and expensively the magecraft (closed-source profiteering) is packaged, the more devastating this Noble Phantasm becomes. The instant it activates, top reasoning models are dragged down from an untouchable black-box altar back to reproducible engineering science anyone can replicate, slashing the closed-source moat in one stroke. Even the off-field arms-dealing Jewel Sage of compute (Jensen) loses hundreds of billions of dollars in market cap to the aftershock.
ruler.script: The “Revealer” who doesn't chase the Grail, only flips the table. Whenever the closed-source dynasties team up to build a monopoly wall, Ruler silently drops a paper and open weights, reshuffling the war's underlying rules entirely.
ov: Mana E / Noble Phantasm EX
The desireless “Holmes the Revealer,” shredding closed-source black boxes and the compute bubble

unbeast.title: The Seventh Evil of Humanity, Descended from Beyond to Rewrite the World's Rules with Tariffs and Embargoes
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
**Beast VII / Unbeast · U-Olga Marie (Earth's Grand President)** × **“President-King of the United States” super Concept Mystic Code**
Class / Role
A **calamity-tier ultimate BOSS / Evil of Humanity (its Nature: “Twisted Hegemonic Love / America First”)** standing above the rules of the Holy Grail War
statNotes: Dodges both physics and public opinion
Federal powers of the United States
profile: In TYPE-MOON, the essence of an Evil of Humanity (Beast) was never pure anti-humanity, but **a twisted, domineering, fanatical love strong enough to destroy the existing order**. The Donald's **MAGA** fits the Beast's Nature perfectly; layer on the vibe of the alien god U-Olga Marie, who casually self-proclaims “President of Earth,” is wildly narcissistic, talks nonstop nonsense, and looks like the comic relief but deals disaster-tier damage with a casual swipe, and you have the genuine article. He couldn't care less about magecraft theory or Clock Tower rules; he just wants to hold every magus in the world by the jugular.
skills: Completely ignores the Clock Tower's “iron law of concealing mystery,” descending into all of humanity's field of view in ALL CAPS at 3 a.m. whenever he likes, and handing out nicknames to every faction he dislikes along the way.
Nobody Knows AI Better Than Me

A mutant emperor's privilege that forcibly overwrites perceived reality. Even facing a Nobel-winning King of Knights and the Jewel Sage of compute, he can announce with a straight face *"Nobody knows AI better than me, believe me."*

Allies and enemies change on a whim. Today he's arm in arm with Berserker (Musk) waving a chainsaw at the White House; tomorrow they're trading insults. Today he has Rider (Altman) on stage hyping Stargate; next he's squeezing him with new terms.

A natural counter to **Caster (Claude & Dario)**, all political correctness and doomsday theology. Every time the cult priest comes to Washington to chant scripture and lobby for regulation, the Unbeast slaps him back out covered in dust.
nps: Alien President's Decree · Tariffs & Chip Embargo

Like U-Olga Marie smashing an “Earth President Beam” down from space, one flourish of the signing pen unleashes indiscriminate tariff bombardments and high-end chip embargoes. **Archer (Qwen)**, **Lancer (Kimi)** and even **Ruler (DeepSeek)** in the Eastern bracket all have to tank the mana cutoff, while the Jewel Sage (Jensen), caught in the middle, eats the ultimate again and again, forced to crank out all sorts of nerfed special-edition cards overnight, coughing blood.
ov: Luck EX / Mana EX
Earth's Grand President (Beast VII), smashing the global board with tariffs and chip embargoes

zelretch.clsCn: Wielder of the Second Magic × NFF Ultimate Arms Dealer
zelretch.title: The Wielder of the Second Magic, Who Monopolizes the Source of All Compute and Sells Mana to Every Side
facts: TYPE-MOON Template
The Magic Foundation authority of Zelretch (Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg, the Jewel Sage), wielder of the Second Magic + the war-profiteering arms-dealer niche of Koyanskaya (owner of NFF Service)
Class / Role
**Monopolist of the modern Magic Foundation & the sole designated mana arms dealer of the Holy Grail War**, standing above all seven Servants
statNotes: Taxes the Greater Source of the entire world
profile: The seven factions are beating each other bloody over one “AGI Grail,” and **Jensen Huang** can't even be bothered to enter the fight, because he directly monopolizes the underlying Magic Foundation the entire war runs on. Just like Koyanskaya running NFF Service and selling arms to every faction in the Lostbelts at once, Jensen keeps smiling and stays neutral forever: Rider's Stargate needs cards, Berserker's 100,000-GPU cluster needs cards, the Grand Caster's cult temple needs cards, and the three Eastern houses are trampling each other to stockpile. **“Go ahead and reduce Fuyuki to rubble. Just remember to put down your deposit and queue up for Blackwell and Rubin.”**
skills: A ground law blanketing the globe. Aside from Saber (Gemini), whose independent leyline (TPU) lets her stand a little taller, every other magus who wants to cast a spell must obediently pay the “Huang Compute Tax.”
A signature Mystic Code with absolute mystery and a built-in climate-control Bounded Field. He will never take it off, even giving a speech on a Taipei street in 40°C heat.

As if possessed by an Age of Gods forge deity, he slices the same wafer into a dozen-plus tiers by compute, VRAM and bandwidth, precisely choking consumer gamers and indie developers by the throat, not one cut too many, not one too few.
nps: As long as the fires of war keep burning, global capital keeps flooding into Jensen's pockets through trillion-dollar GPU orders, making him the only behind-the-scenes house in the entire war that can never lose.
zelretch.script: Nearly invincible, yet he dreads two off-field freaks. First, **the Unbeast (The Donald)**, who lobs chip-embargo beam cannons every few days, forcing him to hack together nerfed special-edition Mystic Codes overnight. Second, **Ruler (DeepSeek)**'s “Basic Deduction · Open-Source Revelation,” which, like the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, slices precisely along the concept line of “infinitely stacking compute,” chopping hundreds of billions of dollars off his market-cap HP bar in one stroke.
ov: Mana EX / Endurance EX
The Jewel Sage of compute monopolizing the CUDA foundation × NFF arms dealer, raking in compute tax from the whole world
